messages:
incident-bot: :pager: PAGER — billing.metering.token_drift detected
Summary: token-ledger vs usage-emitter diverging (~+12% over last 30m). Delayed usage pipeline (consumer lag) + overage flags firing. Runbook: metering-runbook v2. Link: https://runbooks.redwood/metric-drift/1234 

mohit_oncall: ack. oncall here, I'm pulling consumer group offsets and checking pod restarts.

ben_billing: seeing consumer lag ~150k msgs on usage-consumer-3; offsets stuck. k8s pods restarted ~03:12-03:18. sample logs below:
```
WARN 2026-02-18T03:13:22 consumer fetch failed: EOF
ERROR 2026-02-18T03:14:01 commit failed partition=10 OffsetOutOfRange
```

ash_sre: can we mute billing overage alerts while we investigate? suggest suppress for 30m and kick off backfill. runbook step 4.2 -> suppress_alerts.

liz_support: two customers reported overage emails (RWD-112, RWD-118). putting them on temporary do-not-bill and prepping comms. need confirmation to apply credits if we confirm false overages.

kate_eng: quick check SQL to compare counts (run on obsdb):
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM emitted_tokens WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM token_ledger WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour';
```

mohit_oncall: handoff note: I have a meeting in ~20m. if I'm pulled, ash will take over. tagging @ash_sre for takeover.

ben_billing: restarting consumer pod with new image (backpressure fix), bumping replicas to 3. will force rebalance.

ash_sre: enabling alert suppression now :white_check_mark: (suppressing billing.overage.* for 30m).

ben_billing: lag dropping -> 40k now. launching backfill job: k8s job metering-backfill-1987.

liz_support: flagged RWD-112/118 for manual hold and drafted an initial note for CS to call customers. will not send until legal review. :phone:

ops-karen: logs show retry storm from emitter 03:10-03:20, exponential retries amplified backlog. will capture in incident doc.

kate_eng: counts diff (hourly window): emitted=1,216,445 vs ledger=1,099,320 -> ~10.6% delta. aligns with drift seen.

ben_billing: backfill logs sample:
```
INFO 03:28 backfill job started partitions=0-23
INFO 03:30 processed=200k messages elapsed=30s
```

mohit_oncall: handing off active pager to @ash_sre now — I need to step out. ash, please own until counts are within SLA (<=1%).

ash_sre: taking over handoff. monitoring backfill, estimated finish ~18m. keeping suppression until delta <1%.

julia_pm: need customer-impact summary and comms draft post-legal. assigning to liz_support to finalize.

ash_sre: backfill finished, delta at 0.8% :tada: re-enabling alerts in 5m. will remove temp credits after full reconciliation and RCA.

ben_billing: deploying small producer retry-window fix (PR #1123) to avoid retry storms. rolling now with canary 10%.

liz_support: customer notes sent to legal and CS; queued messages ready for send once legal clears.

ops-karen: creating incident ticket INC-198765 and assigning RCA to ben_billing. follow-ups: producer retry tuning, alert tuning, backfill runbook update.

mohit_oncall: thanks all — closing pager. great work. :thumbsup:
